les: Verskillende plekke, verskillende plante en diere
kaps_punt: Baie verskillende plante en diere - daar is baie verskillende plante en diere wat in verskillende habitatte op die Aarde lewe (Suid-Afrika het 'n wye verskeidenheid van inheemse plante en diere en hulle habitatte)

items.bewering: Mense ken al meer as driehonderdduisend soorte plante op die Aarde.
items.bron: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew, State of the World's Plants 2016: about 391 000 vascular plant species known to science (https://news.mongabay.com/2016/05/many-plants-world-scientists-may-now-answer/); Christenhusz & Byng 2016 give about 374 000 plant species in all groups (summarised in the same search). Every current estimate is above 300 000, so 'meer as driehonderdduisend' is safe.

items.bewering: Baie plante van een soort kan saam groei, soos die gras in 'n grasperk.
items.bron: South African lawns are commonly a single grass, most often kikuyu, which outcompetes other turf grasses (https://lawnbyseason.com/za/grass/kikuyu; Johannesburg/Pretoria park turf mainly kikuyu, https://archive.lib.msu.edu/tic/golfd/article/1971feb26a.pdf). The word 'kan' keeps the claim true for mixed lawns too.

items.bewering: Elke plant wat jy sien, behoort tot 'n soort.
items.bron: Species is the basic unit plants are counted in. The Kew species count (https://news.mongabay.com/2016/05/many-plants-world-scientists-may-now-answer/) rests on it.

items.bewering: Blare verskil in vorm en kleur, van lank en smal tot breed en rond. Blomme verskil ook so, van klein wit klokkies tot 'n hibiskus se groot rooi blom wat wyd oopgaan. Vrugte wissel van 'n klein ronde rooi bessie tot 'n lang geel piesang.
items.bron: Hibiscus rosa-sinensis has large trumpet-shaped flowers 10-20 cm across, and red is among its common colours (NParks Singapore flora page, https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/5/9/5928; https://worldplants.ca/display0.php?id=2718). The other examples (narrow and broad leaves, small white bell-shaped flowers, red berries, a long yellow banana) are plain descriptions of common plants. The lesson says 'a hibiscus's large red flower', not that every hibiscus is red, and red ones are common, so this holds.

items.bewering: Dink nou aan 'n olifant en aan 'n miertjie. Albei is diere, en tog verskil hulle in grootte en in byna alles anders.
items.bron: Both are animals (elephant a mammal, ant an insect), and the size difference is many orders of magnitude. This is a contrast, not an analogy, so there is no mapping that could mislead. Checked against standard classification.

items.bewering: Diere verskil ook in vorm: 'n slang is lank en dun, en 'n skilpad is kort en rond.
items.bron: Snakes are defined as limbless reptiles with elongated bodies (https://www.dictionary.com/browse/snake; PBS Nature, https://www.pbs.org/wnet/nature/group/amphibians-reptiles/snake/page/2). Tortoises are compact animals with domed shells (https://discovermagazine.com/planet-earth/shell-shape-helps-tortoises-get-up). 'Dun' is relative to length. Even a thick python is long and narrow for its length, so the contrast holds.

items.bewering: 'n volwasse flamink is pienk
items.bron: Flamingo chicks hatch grey and become pink as adults from carotenoids in their food (WWT, https://wwt.org.uk/news-and-stories/news/turning-pinker-gradually; Live Science, https://livescience.com/32968-why-are-flamingos-pink.html). 'Volwasse' is the right qualifier. Breeding adults can fade towards white late in the season, but adults are correctly described as pink.

items.bewering: 'n renoster is grys
items.bron: IFAW: white and black rhinos are both grey, and the names do not describe their colour (https://www.ifaw.org/animals/black-rhinos).

items.bewering: Laastens is diere se lywe met verskillende dinge bedek. Sommige het hare, ander het vere, en party het skubbe.
items.bron: Zoo education material: mammals have hair or fur, birds feathers, reptiles and fish scales (Toronto Zoo, https://www.torontozoo.com/zootoyou/Animal%20Coverings.pdf; Lincoln Park Zoo, https://www.lpzoo.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/zooexplorers_firstgrade.pdf). 'Sommige / ander / party' does not claim the list is complete, so animals with bare skin, such as frogs, are not excluded.

items.bewering: Die plek waar 'n plant of 'n dier lewe, is sy habitat.
items.bron: Wageningen University glossary: habitat is 'the place where an organism (plant or animal) or a community lives' (https://cascadis.wur.nl/glossary/27_habitat.html); FAO AGROVOC gives the same (https://agrovoc.uniroma2.it/agrovoc/agrovoc/en/page/c_3456).

items.bewering: Jy kry nie elke plant en elke dier op elke plek nie.
items.bron: Follows from the distribution sources below: the king protea, the quiver tree and the springbok each have a limited natural range (Protea Atlas, https://www.proteaatlas.org.za/cpprcyna.htm; SANBI, https://pza.sanbi.org/node/9703; Britannica, https://www.britannica.com/animal/springbok-mammal).

items.bewering: Op die Aarde is daar baie verskillende habitatte, van 'n koue berg tot 'n warm see.
items.bron: NEMBA s1(1) names terrestrial, marine and other aquatic ecosystems as sources of biodiversity (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions); the habitat definition above covers both a mountain and a sea.

items.bewering: In die meeste habitatte lewe baie soorte plante en baie soorte diere saam.
items.bron: A habitat is where a community lives (Wageningen glossary, https://cascadis.wur.nl/glossary/27_habitat.html). The quantifier is right as written: 'die meeste' correctly leaves out habitats with few or no plants, such as caves and the deep sea. Do not change it to 'elke'.

items.bewering: Die soorte in 'n rivier is nie dieselfde as die soorte op 'n droë vlakte nie.
items.bron: Follows from the habitat definition (https://cascadis.wur.nl/glossary/27_habitat.html): an organism lives where its needs are met. The springbok, an animal of dry plains (Britannica, https://www.britannica.com/animal/springbok-mammal), is one example. The claim is about the sets of species, not about every single species, and some animals do move between the two.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika het baie verskillende habitatte: fynbos, grasveld, droë klipvlaktes en 'n lang seekus. Daarom leef 'n wye verskeidenheid inheemse plante en diere hier.
items.blok: Suid-Afrika se eie plante en diere
items.bron: A SANBI keynote attributes South Africa's high biodiversity to a wide range of ecosystems supporting many endemic species (https://satoyamainitiative.org/old/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/Keynote2_Dr.+Abrahamse_SANBI.compressed.pdf). SA has more than 20 400 described plant species and about 67 000 animal species (summarised at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biodiversity_of_South_Africa). The mainland coastline is about 2 800-3 000 km (Daily Maverick, https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2020-10-06-water-water-everywhere-not-any-coastguard-in-sight; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_South_Africa), so 'lang' is fair. The lesson gives no number, and none is needed.

items.bewering: Inheems beteken dat 'n plant of 'n dier vanself hier voorkom. Niemand het hom uit 'n ander land hierheen gebring nie.
items.blok: Suid-Afrika se eie plante en diere
items.bron: NEMBA (Act 10 of 2004) s1(1): an 'indigenous species' is one that 'occurs, or has historically occurred, naturally in a free state in nature within the borders of the Republic, but excludes a species that has been introduced in the Republic as a result of human activity' (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions).

items.bewering: Inheems beteken egter nie dat die plant of dier net hier en nêrens anders voorkom nie. Baie van ons inheemse plante en diere leef ook in ons buurlande.
items.blok: Suid-Afrika se eie plante en diere
items.bron: The NEMBA definition (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions) does not require the species to be found only in South Africa; that is the meaning of 'endemic'. Two of the lesson's own examples also live in neighbouring countries: the quiver tree in southern Namibia (SANBI, https://pza.sanbi.org/node/9703) and the springbok in Botswana and Namibia (Britannica, https://www.britannica.com/animal/springbok-mammal).

items.bewering: Die koningprotea groei in die fynbos op die berge van die Wes-Kaap.
items.bron: Protea Atlas Project: Protea cynaroides occurs from the Cedarberg to Grahamstown, on all mountain ranges in that area except the dry interior ranges, at all elevations from sea level to 1 500 m (https://www.proteaatlas.org.za/cpprcyna.htm); its fynbos habitat is confirmed at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protea_cynaroides. The claim is true as written, because it does grow on the Western Cape mountains. It does not say 'only', so its Eastern Cape range and its lowland plants do not make it false. Do not add 'net' or 'slegs'.

items.bewering: Die kokerboom groei tussen die klippe van die droë Noord-Kaap.
items.bron: SANBI PlantZAfrica, Aloidendron dichotomum: found in the mainly winter-rainfall regions of the Northern Cape and Namibia, on rocky slopes and dry rocky ridges in desert and semi-desert (https://pza.sanbi.org/node/9703; https://treesa.org/?p=10899). Not exclusive, and its Namibian range is consistent with the 'buurlande' sentence.

items.bewering: Die springbok bly op die droë vlaktes van die Karoo en die Kalahari.
items.bron: Britannica: the springbok lives on open, treeless plains in southern Africa, historically a dominant migrant in the Karoo and Highveld, with migratory groups still in the Kalahari (https://www.britannica.com/animal/springbok-mammal; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Springbok).

items.bewering: Biodiversiteit is die verskeidenheid soorte lewende dinge, saam met al die plekke waar hulle lewe.
items.bron: NEMBA s1(1): biodiversity is 'the variability among living organisms from all sources including, terrestrial, marine and other aquatic ecosystems and the ecological complexes of which they are part and also includes diversity within species, between species, and of ecosystems' (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions). The lesson covers diversity between species and of ecosystems ('al die plekke waar hulle lewe'). It leaves out diversity within a species (genetic). That is an omission, not a falsehood, and acceptable at Grade 5. The same check applies to the identical sentence in the closing sentence of the block and to the begrip entry.

items.bewering: Dit is nie net plante en diere nie. Sampioene en baie klein lewende dinge tel ook.
items.bron: NEMBA defines biodiversity over 'living organisms from all sources' (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions). Fungi (mushrooms) and micro-organisms are living organisms and are counted.

items.bewering: Die woord gaan nie oor hoeveel plante daar staan nie, maar oor die verskeidenheid soorte en die plekke waar hulle lewe.
items.bron: NEMBA defines biodiversity as 'variability', not abundance (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions). The contrast with 'how many plants stand there' is accurate.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika se biodiversiteit is dus die verskeidenheid soorte lewende dinge by ons, saam met al die plekke waar hulle lewe.
items.bron: Applies the NEMBA definition (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions) to South Africa. Same remark as the definition above.

items.bewering: habitat: Die plek waar 'n plant of 'n dier lewe.
items.bron: Wageningen University glossary (https://cascadis.wur.nl/glossary/27_habitat.html); FAO AGROVOC (https://agrovoc.uniroma2.it/agrovoc/agrovoc/en/page/c_3456). True on its own, outside its block.

items.bewering: inheems: 'n Plant of dier is inheems as dit vanself in 'n land voorkom en nie deur mense ingebring is nie.
items.bron: Matches the NEMBA s1(1) definition of 'indigenous species': occurs naturally, excluding species introduced through human activity (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions). True on its own, outside its block.

items.bewering: biodiversiteit: Die verskeidenheid soorte lewende dinge, saam met al die plekke waar hulle lewe.
items.bron: NEMBA s1(1) (https://www.acts.co.za/national_environmental_managem/1__definitions). Same wording as the study block, and the same remark applies: diversity within a species is left out, which is acceptable as a simplification.

items.bewering: fynbos: Die Kaap se plantegroei waarin drie groepe plante saam groei: taai struike met fyn blare, proteas en rietagtige restio's.
items.bron: WWF ecoregion AT1203 (https://www.worldwildlife.org/ecoregions/AT1203) and SANParks Bontebok vegetation page (https://www.sanparks.org/parks/bontebok/explore/fauna-flora/vegetation): fynbos is characterised by restioids (Restionaceae, Cape reeds), ericoids (small, narrow, rolled leaves) and proteoids (almost all Proteaceae). Some sources add geophytes as a fourth group. The lesson does not say 'only three', so it holds. 'Die Kaap' is fair for the Western and Eastern Cape fynbos region.

items.bewering: Veral die restio's onderskei fynbos van ander struikveld in die Kaap.
items.bron: Restioids are 'uniquely diagnostic of fynbos', and one definition needs only 5% restioid cover; in renosterveld, proteas, ericas and restios are absent or very sparse (WWF AT1203, https://www.worldwildlife.org/ecoregions/AT1203; SANParks, https://www.sanparks.org/parks/bontebok/explore/fauna-flora/vegetation).

items.bewering: Baie proteas het breë, leeragtige blare, soos die koningprotea.
items.bron: Proteoids have broad leaves (WWF AT1203, https://www.worldwildlife.org/ecoregions/AT1203). Protea cynaroides has large, glossy, 'tough, leathery leaves' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protea_cynaroides, Ecology section; the section is marked as uncited, but the broad hard leaves of proteoids are confirmed separately). 'Baie' rather than 'alle' is right, because some Proteaceae have needle-like leaves.

opsomming: All 30 checkable claims are confirmed, with the NEMBA definitions of 'inheems' and 'biodiversiteit' and the SANBI and Protea Atlas ranges for the three examples. The lesson has no superlatives and no analogy (the elephant and the ant are a contrast, not a comparison that maps). Its quantifiers 'die meeste', 'baie proteas' and the absence of 'net' in the three examples are what keep it true, so they must not be tightened. The only simplification is that 'biodiversiteit' leaves out diversity within a species, which is acceptable at Grade 5.
